name: animated-list
title: Animated list
description: A list whose items enter one by one without shifting the layout.
a11y: A real <ul> with <li> items, so list semantics and counts are announced.
Items fade in with opacity only and keep their space from the first frame; there is no layout shift.
With prefers-reduced-motion all items are visible at once.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between one item entering and the next. Default 300.
